description: This file implements the GetState command handler for a server management system, including a function to convert session states to strings and a class method to process HTTP requests to retrieve the state of an application.

classes.name: GetState
classes.description: A class that handles the 'GetState' command, processing HTTP requests to retrieve application session states.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Converts a SessionServerState enum value to its string representation.

methods.name: GetState::GetState
methods.description: Constructor initializing the GetState handler with service and request references.

methods.name: GetState::run
methods.description: Executes the command to retrieve and reply with the application's session state based on the HTTP request.
